# Changelog

## 9.1.2

- Added a `--sample-flag` option to the `example` command
- Fixed a `"\"` backslash vanishing from sample output
- Fixed sample sessions ending early when `SAMPLE_MODE` is set

## 9.0.1

- New /sample command for trying things out
- Clearer diffs in sample mode
- Faster startup

## 9.0.0

- First sample release
